lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima arranged in five distinct horizontal rows; the primary medial row contains 11 visible circular clusters between the fifth gill slit and the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal spot rows to form a rectilinear grid, with nodes concentrated at the intersections of the medial and sub-medial axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient running parallel to the lateral line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, low-luminance blobs concentrated primarily on the leading edge and base of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior margin of the first dorsal fin exhibits minor irregular notching; no major amputations or deep tissue scarring are visible at this resolution.
other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct commensal organisms (remoras) are attached to the ventral and posterior-medial surfaces of the primary pectoral fin.
